units.SV_VS: same line, shared measurements (SV validation = VS screen); average within line; static line totals r = 0.97 between SV and VS; paired-difference correlation r = 0.19, so averaging lowers SD(diff) 0.458 -> 0.353
units.pairs: recur across lines; line bootstrap = fixed-library scope; two-way variance ratio 3.34, pair-component SE 0.0214 on G (does not shrink with lines)
units.history_dependence: targets share other-line history; line bootstrap ignores it; report per tissue + leave-one-tissue-out
units.tissue_weighting: pancreas = 47% of static* validated discoveries (4.52 per line vs breast 1.19, colon 1.91); report per tissue and absolute per-line difference next to G
units.zero_inflation: 29% of lines have 0 static* validated; 79% of paired differences are 0

bootstrap.primary: stratified percentile line bootstrap of ratio-of-sums G, 10,000 resamples (adequate >= ~40 lines; studentized/BCa or t on mean difference below that)
bootstrap.comparator_reselection: conservative guard; in a frozen 2x2 register the strong baseline from development and report max-over-baselines as sensitivity
bootstrap.two_way: conservative sensitivity, needed only for claims over new pairs
bootstrap.power_check_truncation_bias: power_check.json (Gaussian noise truncated at 0) adds ~+2.5 points spurious gain; superseded by power_check2.json (joint empirical resampling)

within-analysis: no target hidden label in any decision; SV validation (= VS screen) of the target never history; development selection leave-one-tissue-out

multiplicity.future_2x2: one primary (combined arm vs registered strong baseline); model, scheduler, interaction secondary with Holm; simultaneous claims Bonferroni over 3 (n x 1.33); interaction ~2x variance of a main effect

decision_rules.POSITIVE_UNRESOLVED: 0 < L <= tau <= U -> real gain, size unresolved; no meaningful claim
decision_rules.SMALL: L > 0 and U < tau -> real but below bar; adopt only if free at equal rounds and wells
decision_rules.FUTILE: L <= 0 and 0 <= U < tau -> stop pursuing
decision_rules.UNRESOLVED: L <= 0 and U >= tau -> abstain; not evidence of no effect
decision_rules.note: a lower bound below tau never establishes futility

risk_types.marginal: P(act and Y < tau) <= delta for 'act iff certified bound >= tau' when P(bound > Y) <= delta
risk_types.conditional: P(Y < tau | act) <= delta / P(act): uncontrolled when acting is rare
risk_types.example: earlier confirmatory LLM-named arm: marginal FDR 0.043 vs FDP given a non-empty list 0.77 (about 5.6% of lists non-empty)
to_control_conditional: delta <= gamma * p_min with a registered development lower bound p_min on P(act)
Bayesian posterior risk, labelled as such
risk_types.label_scope: certificates control the declared measured label (verification-orientation synergy call), not biological reproducibility

headroom_exploratory.note: oracle_validated buys every validated pair in budget, so the available total bounds any policy's confirmed discoveries at this budget; the scheduler-only ceiling assumes the same screened pairs and verification of every validated screen hit

threshold.recommended_tau_absolute: about 0.095 confirmed discoveries per line at the verify-hits baseline (1.908 per line); about 12 per 125 lines
threshold.conditions: equal wells (+-0.5%) and no more rounds than the comparator; otherwise a time-matched comparison with measured extra controls and days
judgement_parts: a positive bar rather than any L > 0: protects against adopting complexity for gains of the size that did not transfer here (+2-3% screen-level ALMANAC/Jaaks S1; +9-15% O'Neil vanished on independent measurement) while the verify-hits allocation effect survived
5% sits above residual accounting artefacts (odd-budget remainder ~1.5% averaged; old avoidable underuse 4.95%) and is ~1/7 of attainable headroom and half the scheduler-only ceiling
10% would make a pure scheduler contribution with unchanged screens nearly impossible (ceiling 9.6%)

sample_size.sd_source: back-calculated from the earlier follow-up interval (feedback-verify-hits minus static-verify-hits; verify-hits minus paired gives 0.422); single-assignment SD scaled by the observed single/averaged ratio 1.30
sample_size.check: power_check2.json joint empirical resampling agrees with the normal approximation within MC error (e.g. L > 0 at G = 10%, 40 lines: 0.85-0.98 resampled vs 0.87-0.98 predicted)

multipliers.policy_disagreement: observed SDs come from policies differing on ~21% of lines; the random-ranking contrast SD 1.94 is an extreme upper bound; re-estimate on the repaired replay before freezing n

sample_size.consequence: resolving tau = 5% in both directions needs ~146 lines (two role assignments per line) or ~245 (one); more than any single anchored screen (Jaaks 125, Nair 81, Nair validation 15); at Jaaks size pre-register UNRESOLVED as the likely outcome for true gains of 0-10%; a 60-line gate is arbitrary (too many for 15% effects, too few for the 5% bar)
